readout_other: NPU threat task anxiety ratings (APR, FPR); EMG startle; EEG ERP at Cz; heart rate; electrodermal response; STAI-S
direction_notes: vAI LIFU reduced anxiety-potentiated ratings (and startle EMG, HR, EEG in APR/FPR); aMCC LIFU reduced fear-potentiated ratings and FPR-related EEG and HR, relative to sham.
safety_notes: Review of symptoms questionnaire before and at least 30 minutes after LIFU; modelled maximum brain temperature 37.4 C.

exposures.label: LIFU to right ventral anterior insula (vAI)

timing.protocol_description: Tapered 10 Hz gating (N = 400) of a 500 kHz sine wave with a pulse duration of 30 ms and pulse repetition interval of 100 ms, 40 s total LIFU application delivered once, about 5 minutes before the NPU task.

exposures.label: LIFU to right anterior mid-cingulate cortex (aMCC)

timing.protocol_description: Tapered 10 Hz gating (N = 400) of a 500 kHz sine wave with a pulse duration of 30 ms and pulse repetition interval of 100 ms, 40 s total LIFU application delivered once, about 5 minutes before the NPU task.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The Virginia Tech Institutional Review Board approved all experimental procedures (VT-IRB #23-192). $\mathsf { N } = 4 0$ healthy participants (12M/28F, aged $2 6 . 2 \pm 5 . 8$ years); range (18-42)
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The remaining three visits were formal testing sessions of LIFU to the right anterior insula (AI), right dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (aMCC), or sham, randomized between and within subjects

flags.reason: Peak negative pressure ~900 kPa and 27 W/cm2 Isppa described as 'outside the head' for all participants; medium not named, so placed in unspecified_domain. No in situ values reported (k-Wave simulations done but values not given in the text).
Same free-field-like value applied to the aMCC transducer (H-104) as stated for all participants.
Paper's methods call the target 'right dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (aMCC)'; elsewhere anterior mid-cingulate cortex.
Active sham: a high-impedance material inserted into the gel attenuated the ultrasound before the skull; coded as inactive_transducer.
Four visits, of which three (vAI, aMCC, sham) were LIFU/sham sessions; the first visit was imaging only.
